thread:
maria: Heads up — aiming to publish the release announcement Thu 11am PT (moved from 10). Need final changelog link, docs URLs, and a confirmed demo/webinar slot for the announcement post. @sam @tayler @lee can you confirm what's possible? :spiral_calendar:

sam: I can cut the changelog PR by EOD tomorrow. Need the marketing summary bullets and the highlighted benchmark points (latency/cost streaming). Will include a rollback note.

maria: I'll post the 3 headline options + benchmark blurb tonight. Make sure the changelog calls out the streaming + batching improvements.

tayler: Docs: I can update Quickstart and Embeddings guide once I have the final API sample and the PR link. Prefer canonical anchors so marketing links deep into sections.

lee: Product is ok with 11am PT if legal finishes the compliance check. If legal flags anything, we'll need a short delay — heads up.

maria: noted — leaning 11am to give legal runway. @sam can you still do EOD tomorrow for the PR?

sam: Yep. I'll open PR titled `release: vX.Y.Z changelog + notes` and include an abbreviated changelog in the description. I'll paste the reproducible run command in the PR too: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-alpha --quantization q4_0 --seq 1024`

tayler: Perfect. If you drop the PR link here I can start drafting the docs patch and stage the demo snippets. Also need the webinar host and Zoom/stream link to embed in the announcement.

maria: Host = maria. @ben (ops) can you create the webinar room and share the link before EOD tomorrow? We'll enable registration. :wave:

ben (ops): On it — will create Zoom, set registration, and drop link in #marketing by 5pm tomorrow.

maria: Marketing will prepare 3 headline options, a short benchmark narrative, and the lead routing spreadsheet (inbound tags + funnel mapping). I'll share by EOD today for quick edits. :rocket:

sam: Also please include exact model/quantization specs in docs so benchmarks are reproducible. I'll confirm model sha and config in the PR.

tayler: ack — I'll add a 'repro steps' section with a fenced code block and the exact flags.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule release after changelog PR merged and docs pushed. Use `/release schedule 2024-05-15T18:00Z` (example).

maria: Summary / action items: move announce to 11am PT, @sam changelog PR by EOD tomorrow, @tayler draft docs after PR link, @ben ops webinar link by 5pm tomorrow, marketing headlines tonight. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
